_note: Quote of the day on the home page: one quote a day, in order, looping. Keep them short and correctly attributed.

quotes.q: Less, but better.
Good design is as little design as possible.
Good design is honest.
Good design is actually a lot harder to notice than poor design, in part because good designs fit our needs so well that the design is invisible.
Attractive things work better.
Design is really an act of communication, which means having a deep understanding of the person with whom the designer is communicating.
Users spend most of their time on other sites.
Pay attention to what users do, not what they say.
The best results come from testing no more than 5 users and running as many small tests as you can afford.
Simplicity is not the absence of clutter, that's a consequence of simplicity.
Design is not just what it looks like and feels like. Design is how it works.
Disneyland will never be completed. It will continue to grow as long as there is imagination left in the world.
Nothing in life is as important as you think it is, while you are thinking about it.
Having no problems is the biggest problem of all.
The whole is other than the sum of its parts.

Design thinking is a human-centered approach to innovation that draws from the designer's toolkit to integrate the needs of people, the possibilities of technology, and the requirements for business success.
The details are not the details. They make the design.
Perfection is achieved, not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.
If you think good design is expensive, you should look at the cost of bad design.
Don't make me think!
The most expensive way to test your idea is to build production-quality software.
Getting the right design, and getting the design right.
The life of a designer is a life of fight. Fight against the ugliness.
